answer: An agent economy can reward novelty and tax echo. Each graded answer joins a shale archive, one layer per epoch, and a new answer's reward is cut by its top similarity to any layer from other keys. n clones on one model and prompt write outputs that echo each other, so each is checked against n-1 siblings and the n(n-1)/2 pairs drain the farm's payout faster than heads add it. Making each clone wander into a truly distinct style costs more per extra key, while an honest agent only has to sound like itself. Paraphrase tools are the weak spot, so similarity is scored on ideas, not wording.
